name: hastebin-ansi
author: freelance@harrydev.me
description: Hastebin paste server with ANSI color support. The server image is built by GitHub Actions and pulled again when the server restarts, so updates arrive on restart. The install script only writes config.yaml and creates the data folder.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# hastebin-ansi install script.
# Nothing is compiled here: the server binary ships in the Docker image,
# which GitHub Actions builds. This only prepares the server folder.
set -e
cd /mnt/server

DATA_DIR="${STORAGE_FILE_PATH:-data}"

# Remove leftovers of the old egg, which built from source.
# Only these exact names are removed. The data dir is never touched.
for f in hastebin hastebin-ansi static cmd config handler internal .github .git \
    go.mod go.sum Dockerfile .dockerignore .gitignore docker-compose.yaml docker-compose.yml \
    README.md LICENSE about.md config.yaml.example config.example.yaml; do
    if [ "$f" = "$DATA_DIR" ] || [ "$f" = "data" ]; then
        continue
    fi
    if [ -e "$f" ] || [ -L "$f" ]; then
        echo "Removing old build file: $f"
        rm -rf "./$f"
    fi
done

# Keep the previous config as a backup
if [ -f config.yaml ]; then
    echo "Saving the old config.yaml as config.yaml.bak"
    mv -f config.yaml config.yaml.bak
fi

# Fresh config. Egg variables (environment) override these values at startup.
cat > config.yaml <<'EOF'
host: "0.0.0.0"
port: 7777
key_length: 10
max_length: 4000000
# Paste lifetime in seconds, 0 means pastes never expire
expiration: 0
key_generator: "phonetic"

storage:
  type: "file"
  file_path: "data"

documents:
  - key: "about"
    path: "/opt/hastebin/about.md"

rate_limiting:
  enable: true
  limit: 500
  window: 15

logging:
  level: "info"
  colorize: false
EOF

mkdir -p data
echo "Install done. The server binary comes from the Docker image."

variables.name: Storage Type
variables.description: Where pastes are stored: file, redis, memcached, mongodb, postgres or s3.

variables.name: Storage File Path
variables.description: Folder for pastes when Storage Type is file, relative to the server folder.

variables.name: Key Length
variables.description: Length of the paste keys in the URL.

variables.name: Key Generator
variables.description: How paste keys are made: phonetic (easy to read) or random.

variables.name: Rate Limit Enable
variables.description: Limit the number of requests per client IP.

variables.name: Rate Limit Requests
variables.description: Requests allowed per client IP in each window.

variables.name: Rate Limit Window
variables.description: Length of the rate limit window, in seconds.

variables.name: Trusted Proxies
variables.description: Comma separated IPs or CIDRs of the reverse proxy allowed to pass the real client IP, for example the address cloudflared comes from (172.18.0.1). Only safe if the server port is not reachable directly from the internet. Leave empty to ignore client IP headers.

variables.name: Real IP Header
variables.description: Header that carries the client IP from the trusted proxy: CF-Connecting-IP for cloudflared, X-Real-IP, or X-Forwarded-For.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public URL used in links returned by /log, for example https://paste.example.com. Leave empty to use the request host.

variables.name: Metrics Address
variables.description: Address for a separate Prometheus metrics listener, for example 127.0.0.1:9100. Leave empty to turn metrics off.
